extracted.intended_audience: NIH extramural community — researchers, grant applicants, and institutional research administrators
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on where NIH Notices of Funding Opportunities (NOFOs) will be published starting FY2026 and how applicants should find and receive notifications about NIH funding opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official posting source for NOFOs
rubrics_metrics.description: Beginning in fiscal year 2026, Grants.gov will serve as NIH’s single official source for grant and cooperative agreement funding opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Since 2005 NIH posted NOFOs in both Grants.gov and the NIH Guide; this Notice informs the extramural community that NIH will no longer post NOFOs in the NIH Guide and that Grants.gov will be the single official source going forward.

rubrics_metrics.name: NIH Guide role after FY2026
rubrics_metrics.description: The NIH Guide for Grants and Contracts will continue to be used for policy and informational notices, but will no longer post NOFOs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NOFOs will no longer be accessible from the NIH Guide; policy and informational notices remain the Guide's purpose.

rubrics_metrics.name: Searchability of NOFOs on Grants.gov
rubrics_metrics.description: All NIH NOFOs (expired and active) will remain searchable on Grants.gov using their Classic search or their new Simpler search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users should use Grants.gov searches to find both active and expired NIH funding opportunities; any funding opportunity identified through the NIH Grants & Funding site will link to Grants.gov for the official posting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscription and notification services
rubrics_metrics.description: NOFOs will no longer be included in the weekly NIH Guide Table of Contents subscription emails; use Grants.gov subscription services to receive notifications of new NIH funding opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Switch subscription preferences to Grants.gov subscription services to receive timely notices of new NIH funding opportunities since NIH Guide TOC emails will no longer carry NOFOs.

rubrics_metrics.name: NIH Grants & Funding site as a signposting tool
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH will continue to provide tools in the Funding section of NIH Grants & Funding to identify potential funding categories, topics, and opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any funding opportunity identified through NIH’s site will link to Grants.gov for the official opportunity posting; the NIH site serves as a discovery aid rather than the posting authority for NOFOs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effective date of change
rubrics_metrics.description: The change in posting practice takes effect beginning fiscal year 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notice release date: August 14, 2025; plan accordingly for NOFOs issued in FY2026 and beyond.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rationale for change
rubrics_metrics.description: This effort is part of a wider strategy across NIH to simplify and streamline the application and funding process and to reduce duplication across federal systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The move centralizes official NOFO postings on Grants.gov to simplify processes for applicants and reduce redundant posting across systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Point of contact for inquiries
rubrics_metrics.description: Direct all inquiries regarding this change to the NIH Office of Extramural Research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the NIH Office of Extramural Research as the contact for questions about finding NIH funding opportunities or the transition of NOFO postings.
